jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.content: <p>We are hiring a <strong>Senior Backend Engineer</strong> for our payments platform.</p><h3>What you&#39;ll do</h3><ul><li>Design and ship Python services on AWS</li><li>Own PostgreSQL schema design and query performance</li><li>Mentor engineers across two squads</li></ul><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>5+ years backend experience</li><li>Strong Python and SQL</li><li>EU work authorisation</li></ul>
